resources: Various kinds of functional texts (e.g., recipes, product manuals, transport schedules, forms, brochures, menus)

specific_competences.main_competence: Provide basic English language services to the community
specific_competences.specific_competence: Apply principles of editing and proofreading in a variety of texts
learning_activities: (a) Edit and proofread texts in a school context (e.g., school rules and regulations, essays/ compositions)
(b) Edit and proofread short texts in contexts outside the school (e.g. posters, flyers, user manuals)
teaching_methods: Pair work: Guide the students in pairs through editing and proofreading short texts found in the school context and presenting their work to the class
Group work: Guide the students in groups through editing and proofreading short texts found outside the school context and presenting their work to the class
assessment_criteria: Texts found in the school context are edited and proofread appropriately
Texts found outside the school context are edited and proofread appropriately
resources: Relevant texts, school rules and regulations, fliers, user manuals, various essays/ compositions, dictionaries

specific_competences.main_competence: Provide basic English language services to the community
specific_competences.specific_competence: Apply principles of interpretation to provide simple authentic interpretations
learning_activities: (a) Interpret messages in informal contexts (e.g., family conversations and peer conversations) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
(b) Interpret messages in small formal settings (e.g., classroom and subject group discussions) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
(c) Interpret messages in large formal settings (e.g., church, mosque and meetings) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa).
teaching_methods: Simultaneous and consecutive interpretation: Guide the students in pairs through simultaneous and consecutive interpretation to interpret messages in informal contexts
Roleplay: Guide the students in pairs through roleplaying the role of the speaker and interpreter in interpreting messages in small formal settings
Simultaneous and consecutive interpretation: Guide the students in pairs through interpreting messages in informal contexts using simultaneous and consecutive interpretation
assessment_criteria: Messages in informal contexts are interpreted correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
Messages in small formal settings are interpreted correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
Messages in large formal settings are interpreted correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
resources: Dictionaries, oral texts, audio and audio- visual materials (audio/video clips, recorded stories)

specific_competences.main_competence: Provide basic English language services to the community
specific_competences.specific_competence: Apply principles of translation to produce simple authentic translation
learning_activities: (a) Translate texts in contexts outside the school (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
(b) Translate a variety of short texts (e.g., advertisements and functional texts) (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
(c) Translate a variety of long texts (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
teaching_methods: Collaborative and independent practice: Guide the students in groups and individually through translating texts found outside the school context using communicative translation
Collaborative and independent practice: Guide the students in groups and individually through translating a variety of short texts using communicative translation
Collaborative and independent practice: Guide the students in pairs and individually through translating a variety of long texts using communicative translation
assessment_criteria: Texts found outside the school context are translated correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
A variety of short texts are translated correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
A variety of long texts are translated correctly (from English to Kiswahili and vice versa)
resources: Dictionaries, a variety of texts

specific_competences.main_competence: Provide basic English language services to the community
specific_competences.specific_competence: Manage short translation and editing projects using Computer- Assisted Tools
learning_activities: (a) Desribe the use of Computer- Assisted Tools in translating and editing
(b) Use Computer- Assisted Translation Tools to translate and edit short simple texts
teaching_methods: Group work: Guide the students in groups through describing the use of Computer Assisted Tools in translating and editing

Exploration: Guide the students through exploring the Computer- Assisted Tools used for translation and editing Modelling/demonstration: Demonstrate to the students how to use Computer-Assisted Tools in translating and editing texts Shared practice: Work with the students to translate and edit texts using Computer-Assisted Translation Tools Collaborative and independent practice: Guide the students in groups and individually through translating and editing texts using Computer-Assisted Tools
assessment_criteria: The use of Computer- Assisted Tools in translating and editing is described correctly
Computer- Assisted Translation Tools are used appropriately to translate and edit short simple texts
resources: Dictionaries, a variety of texts

specific_competences.specific_competence: Appreciate the aesthetics and value of literature
learning_activities: (a) Assess the language used in a selected novella
(b) Compare own values and perspectives with those implied in a selected novella
(c) Dramatise episodes from a selected novella
teaching_methods: Brainstorming: Guide the students through brainstorming techniques for analysing language in texts Close reading: Guide the students through assessing the language used in the novella read and presenting their work to the class

TIPS: Guide the students through identifying their own values and perspectives using TIPS Pair work: Guide the students in pairs through comparing own values and perspectives with those implied in the selected novella
Dramatisation: Guide the students in groups through dramatising episodes from the selected novella
assessment_criteria: The language used in the selected novella is assessed appropriately
Own values and perspectives are compared appropriately with those implied in the selected novella
Episodes from the selected novella are dramatised properly
resources: A variety of literary texts, dictionaries

specific_competences.specific_competence: Evaluate the context in which literary texts are written, read and understood
learning_activities: (a) Examine the socio-political and cultural issues portrayed in a selected novella
(b) Relate the context of the story in a selected novella to real life experiences
teaching_methods: Brainstorming: Guide the students in groups through brainstorming ideas about socio- political and cultural issues and presenting their work to the class Group work: Guide the students in groups through examining the socio-political and cultural issues portrayed in the selected novella and presenting their work to the class
Discussion: Guide the students through discussing the context of a story in the selected novella, relating it to real-life experiences and presenting their work to the class
assessment_criteria: The socio- political and cultural issues portrayed in the selected novella are examined properly
The context of the story in the selected novella is related appropriately to real-life experiences
resources: A variety of literary texts, dictionaries

specific_competences.specific_competence: Analyse genres of literature and appreciate their conventions
learning_activities: (a) Analyse techniques of critiquing literary texts based on their conventions
(b) Critique a selected novella based on form and content
teaching_methods: Gallery walk: Guide the students through analysing and presenting techniques for critiquing literary texts using gallery walk
Group work: Guide the students in groups through critiquing the novella based on form and content and presenting the work to the class
assessment_criteria: Techniques for critiquing literary texts based on their conventions are analysed appropriately
The selected novella is critiqued appropriately based on form and content
resources: A variety of literary texts, dictionaries

specific_competences.specific_competence: Create simple literary works
learning_activities: (a) Apply literary skills to compose short stories on various topics
(b) Publish the short stories on various platforms (e.g., note boards and online platforms)
teaching_methods: Brainstorming: Guide the students through brainstorming ideas on the skills required in composing short stories and presenting the work to the class Collaborative and independent practice: Guide the students in groups and individually through composing short stories on various topics Follow-up: Check the correctness of the stories(e.g., a series of events, coherence and language used)
Project work: Guide the students through publishing the short stories they have created on various platforms (e.g., note boards and the Internet)
assessment_criteria: Literary skills are applied appropriately to compose short stories on various topics
Short stories are published appropriately on various platforms
